# Pinned third-party components.
#
# One record per component. `bundle` decides whether Build-Release.ps1 puts the
# artifact inside our release archives or leaves the installer to fetch it at
# install time — see third_party/README.md for why PawnIO is the latter.
#
# Fields:
#   id       stable key used by the scripts
#   version  upstream version, for the notices and the update contract
#   url      exact artifact URL, never a "latest" redirect
#   sha256   verified on download; a mismatch aborts rather than warns
#   licence  SPDX id where there is one
#   bundle   yes = ship it in our archives, no = installer downloads it
#
# To move a version: change version + url, run Fetch-ThirdParty.ps1, paste the
# hash it reports, re-run to confirm, commit.

id       = librehardwaremonitor
version  = 0.9.6
url      = https://github.com/LibreHardwareMonitor/LibreHardwareMonitor/releases/download/v0.9.6/LibreHardwareMonitor.zip
sha256   = 086d9f1b5a99e643edc2cfaaac16051685b551e4c5ac0b32a57c58c0e529c001
licence  = MPL-2.0
bundle   = yes

id       = pawnio
version  = 2.2.0
url      = https://github.com/namazso/PawnIO.Setup/releases/download/2.2.0/PawnIO_setup.exe
sha256   = 1f519a22e47187f70a1379a48ca604981c4fcf694f4e65b734aaa74a9fba3032
licence  = GPL-2.0-or-later (driver source); signed setup has no stated licence
bundle   = no

id       = presentmon
version  = 2.5.1
url      = https://github.com/GameTechDev/PresentMon/releases/download/v2.5.1/PresentMon-2.5.1-x64.exe
sha256   = 9bec3083069f58f911e6a512f4806db51a27bd096103087bc1d05ef54c80a191
licence  = MIT
bundle   = yes
